title: StaticColumnPayload
description: One column declaration in POST /api/data-sources/static's `columns[]` (HEL-906 cycle 5, AC-3: `type` must be a canonical DataFieldType wire value -- validated server-side via DataFieldType.validateAndCanonicalize, 400 on failure -- and this enum makes that contract explicit at the schema level too). `required`/`default` (HEL-1076 design.md Decision 6) are optional; an absent `required` defaults to `false` and an absent `default` defaults to unset. `default`'s JSON shape, if present, must itself satisfy `type`'s validation rules -- enforced server-side at declaration time, not by this schema.
